Transform colors from hexadecimal format to rgba hc notation

Source: R/helpers.R
hex_to_rgba.Rd

Transform colors from hexadecimal format to rgba hc notation

Usage

hex_to_rgba(x, alpha = 1)

Arguments

x

colors in hexadecimal format

alpha

alpha

Examples


hex_to_rgba(c("#440154", "#21908C", "#FDE725", "red"))
#> [1] "rgba(68,1,84,1)"    "rgba(33,144,140,1)" "rgba(253,231,37,1)"
#> [4] "rgba(255,0,0,1)"   

hchart(iris, "scatter", hcaes(Sepal.Length, Petal.Length),
  color = hex_to_rgba("#0072B2", alpha = 0.4))
